name: Agent work queue
blurb: A dependency-aware issue queue for coding agents, in the style of beads: file work, link what waits on what, claim what is ready, close it.
about: Build a living work queue for coding agents, and the agent workflows around it. It keeps issues, what waits on what, claims, comments and project memories linked, so every agent works from one current picture. Whether an issue is ready or blocked is worked out from its links on every read, and a claim goes to exactly one agent. Agents file, claim and close work, and plans go on branches an admin reviews before they reach the main queue.

questions.q: What can an agent claim now?
What is blocked, and by what?
Which blocks does an issue inherit from its parents?
What depends on this issue, directly or not?
